target.title: feat: add message stats
target.body:
## Summary
- add read-only MessageStore stats aggregation for messages by chat, handle, service, and day
- add optional media attachment totals grouped by UTI/MIME and chat
- expose stats via `imsg stats`, `server.getMessageStats`, `getMediaStatistics`, and `getMediaStatisticsByChat`
- document the CLI/RPC surface and update the imsg skill/changelog

## Verification
- `make build` ✅
- release binary smoke test against a temporary SQLite fixture ✅
- before/after proof on lobster ✅
- CI macOS lint failure addressed by moving stats RPC handlers out of `RPCServer+Handlers.swift` (`608` → `580` lines) ✅
- `make test` ⚠️ blocked before project tests run locally: SwiftPM cannot import the repo-wide `Testing` module (`no such module 'Testing'`) with Apple Swift 6.3.1 on this host
- `make lint` ⚠️ on lobster: `swift format lint` completed, then local `swiftlint` crashed loading `sourcekitdInProc.framework`; CI uses SwiftLint successfully and is the source of truth for lint

## Proof
